{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check if any revenue values contain commas and are not '999999.99'
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
comma_rows = df[has_commas & (df['revenue'] != '999999.99')]

# Show the unique values
print(comma_rows['revenue'].unique())"}
